title: Do Waqt Ki Roti
desc: When a notorious criminal breaks out of prison, Jailer Vijay resigns and vows to arrest him. However, Shankar, a brother set on avenging his sister's death, stands in Vijay's way.

title: Ghar Ka Chiraag
desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Years later, her partner returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.

title: Dil Tera Aashiq
desc: Thakur Ranvir Singh Chaudhary cuts ties with his sister after she marries a man from a different background. However, when she dies, the responsibility of looking after her children falls on him.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.
